hypotheses.rationale: Evidence continues to support single occupancy (one mug, one set of dining ware used for lunch/dinner). The consistent 18:13 dinner time and morning coffee routine strongly suggest a standard 9-5 work schedule. Dog bed usage remains consistent.

Still possible if the second person is extremely minimalist or works from home using different utensils, but the lack of any second-person artifacts (second mug, second plate, different clothing items) makes this increasingly unlikely. The 'single mug' pattern is strong.
Routine is too rigid and established (same times, same items) for a short-term stay. The consistency over 3 days suggests long-term residency.
